title: NAS-5GS: Parse URSP Location criteria route selection descriptor
description:
## Summary

Add parsing for the Location criteria route selection descriptor component (type 0x40) in URSP rules, which was previously showing "IE not dissected yet".

## Problem

The route selection descriptor parser (`de_nas_5gs_ursp_r_sel_desc`) is missing a `case 0x40` handler. When this type is encountered, the `default` branch displays "IE not dissected yet" and abandons parsing of all subsequent components in the same RSD contents block.

## Specification Reference

3GPP TS 24.526 Section 5.2, Table 5.2.2:

> For "Location criteria type", the route selection descriptor component value field may contain one or more types of location area and is encoded as a sequence of a one octet length field and a location criteria value field.

### Encoding structure

```
Location criteria value field:
  Length of location criteria (1 octet)
  Location area 1:  Type of location area (1 octet) + Location area contents
  Location area 2:  Type of location area (1 octet) + Location area contents
  ...
  Location area m:  Type of location area (1 octet) + Location area contents
```

### Type of location area (Table 5.2.2)

| Value | Name | Location area contents |
|-------|------|----------------------|
| 0x01 | E-UTRA cell identities list | Number of E-UTRA cell identities (1) + [E-UTRA cell id (7 octets)] × N |
| 0x02 | NR cell identities list | Number of NR cell identities (1) + [NR cell id (8 octets)] × N |
| 0x03 | Global RAN node identities list | Number of Global gNB identities (1) + [Global gNB id (7 octets)] × N |
| 0x04 | TAI list | TAI list IE starting from octet 2 (TS 24.501 clause 9.11.3.9) |

### Cell identity encoding (TS 38.413)

| Type | Octet size | Encoding reference | Composition |
|------|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| E-UTRA cell id | 7 | TS 38.413 clause 9.3.1.9 | PLMN (3) + ECI (4) |
| NR cell id | 8 | TS 38.413 clause 9.3.1.7 | PLMN (3) + NCI (5) |
| Global gNB id | 7 | TS 38.413 clause 9.3.1.6 | PLMN (3) + gNB ID (4) |

NOTE: If the Global gNB id field includes a gNB id with a length of less than 32 bits, the most significant bits of the 4 octets field containing the gNB id are padded with zeros.

## Changes

- Added `case 0x40` handler with full parsing for all 4 location area types
- Type-specific `hf` fields for cell count:
  - `hf_nas_5gs_ursp_r_sel_desc_loc_num_eutra_cells` — "Number of E-UTRA cell identities"
  - `hf_nas_5gs_ursp_r_sel_desc_loc_num_nr_cells` — "Number of NR cell identities"
  - `hf_nas_5gs_ursp_r_sel_desc_loc_num_gnb_ids` — "Number of Global gNB identities"
- Per-cell subtree with PLMN decoding via `dissect_e212_mcc_mnc()` + cell-specific ID field
- TAI list (type 0x04) reuses existing `de_nas_5gs_mm_5gs_ta_id_list()`
- `value_string` table uses exact spec terminology from Table 5.2.2

## Design Decisions

| Element | Approach | Reference |
|---------|----------|-----------|
| Cell identity subtree | `proto_tree_add_subtree_format()` per cell | `de_nas_5gs_mm_s_nssai_loc_valid_info()` |
| PLMN decoding | `dissect_e212_mcc_mnc()` with `E212_5GSTAI` | Same function used in `de_nas_5gs_mm_5gs_ta_id_list()` |
| NR Cell ID | `FT_UINT40, BASE_HEX` (5 bytes) | `hf_nas_5gs_mm_s_nssai_loc_valid_info_per_s_nssai_nr_cell_id` |
| E-UTRA Cell ID | `FT_UINT32, BASE_HEX` (4 bytes) | Same pattern |
| gNB ID | `FT_UINT32, BASE_HEX` (4 bytes) | Same pattern |
| TAI list | Reuse `de_nas_5gs_mm_5gs_ta_id_list()` | Already called in 5 other places |

## Testing

Verified with 5 pcap files covering all location area types:

| pcap | Type | Before | After |
|------|------|--------|-------|
| RSD_0x40_1_location_NCI | NR cell identities list (0x02) | IE not dissected yet | Subtree per cell: MCC/MNC + NR Cell ID |
| RSD_0x40_2_location_ECI | E-UTRA cell identities list (0x01) | IE not dissected yet | Subtree per cell: MCC/MNC + E-UTRA Cell ID |
| RSD_0x40_3_location_gNB-ID | Global RAN node identities list (0x03) | IE not dissected yet | Subtree per cell: MCC/MNC + gNB ID |
| RSD_0x40_4_location_TAI | TAI list (0x04) | IE not dissected yet | Partial TAI lists via existing parser |
| RSD_0x40_5_location_combined | Multiple types | IE not dissected yet | All types parsed correctly |

Reproduction pcaps:
- [RSD_0x40_1_location_NCI.pcap](https://gitlab.com/-/project/82634231/uploads/c0d08a309c7fafdff534f6ac0ee51b5d/RSD_0x40_1_location_NCI.pcap)
- [RSD_0x40_2_location_ECI.pcap](https://gitlab.com/-/project/82634231/uploads/8c1fdb55c485f04ddfda9bd2af846e64/RSD_0x40_2_location_ECI.pcap)
- [RSD_0x40_3_location_gNB-ID.pcap](https://gitlab.com/-/project/82634231/uploads/15f34563dc6af822299b122f083d5684/RSD_0x40_3_location_gNB-ID.pcap)
- [RSD_0x40_4_location_TAI.pcap](https://gitlab.com/-/project/82634231/uploads/99a91bf9ba8eb47f5d898fbc2a792c9f/RSD_0x40_4_location_TAI.pcap)
- [RSD_0x40_5_location_combined.pcap](https://gitlab.com/-/project/82634231/uploads/7401adbcfee8c98c39be640aa2ad959d/RSD_0x40_5_location_combined.pcap)
